title: Convention of Cintra
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Convention of Cintra", at revision 1375289710, opens: "The Convention of Cintra was an agreement signed on 30 August 1808, during the Peninsular War. By the agreement, the defeated French were allowed to evacuate their troops from Portugal without further conflict. The convention was signed at the Palace of Queluz, in Queluz, Cintra, Estremadura." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q277204, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1808 agreement allowing French troops to evacuate from Portugal". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
